description: This PHP source file defines the class ElasticSearchIndexer within the SuiteCRM project. It manages creating, deleting, and updating Elasticsearch indexes for SuiteCRM modules, including batch indexing, handling index metadata, and connection health checks.

classes.name: ElasticSearchIndexer
classes.description: A class responsible for managing Elasticsearch indexing operations such as creating/deleting indices, indexing beans, batch operations, and maintaining index metadata for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initiates the indexing process for all configured modules, handling full or differential indexing.

methods.name: removeIndex
methods.description: Deletes a specific Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates a new Elasticsearch index with optional configuration.

methods.name: indexModule
methods.description: Indexes all beans within a specified module, optionally performing differential indexing based on the last run.

methods.name: indexBeans
methods.description: Indexes a batch of beans, updating counts and logging results.

methods.name: indexBean
methods.description: Indexes a single bean into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Removes a specified bean from Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: removeBeans
methods.description: Removes multiple beans from Elasticsearch index in batch.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks connectivity to Elasticsearch server, returning response time or false on failure.

methods.name: putMeta
methods.description: Stores metadata information such as last index time within the index for a module.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information for a module stored in Elasticsearch.

methods.name: getBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the configured batch size for bulk indexing.

methods.name: setBatchSize
methods.description: Sets the batch size for bulk indexing.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the current index name.

methods.name: setIndex
methods.description: Sets the index name to use for Elasticsearch operations.

methods.name: indexBatch
methods.description: Prepares and sends a batch of beans to Elasticsearch for indexing or deletion.

methods.name: differentialIndexing
methods.description: Determines whether differential indexing is enabled based on last run timestamp.

methods.name: makeIndexParamsBodyFromBean
methods.description: Generates the Elasticsearch document body for a given bean.

methods.name: sendBatch
methods.description: Sends the batch request to Elasticsearch and handles errors, updating counts accordingly.

methods.name: makeIndexParamsFromBean
methods.description: Creates a complete indexing request payload from a bean.

methods.name: makeParamsHeaderFromBean
methods.description: Creates request header parameters for a bean.

methods.name: getModuleLastIndexed
methods.description: Retrieves the last index timestamp for a module from metadata.

methods.name: repairElasticsearchIndex
methods.description: Static method to rebuild or repair Elasticsearch index, optionally using specific search definitions.
